## Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`
- [ ] Desktop behavior tested on the stated platform

## Privacy

- [ ] No account email, token, cookie, API key, device code, local path or `data.json` is included.
- [ ] No generated sidecar, dependency directory, build cache or installer is committed.

## Screenshots

If applicable, attach screenshots with personal data removed.
